ns2:course.label: Etruscan and Italic Art
ns2:course.description: History of early Italic and Etruscan sculpture, painting, and architecture from c. 1000 B.C. to the first century B.C. Emphasis on the international context of Etruscan art and architecture. Same as CLCV 418. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing or consent of instructor.
